text:
nina.docs: holding PR #4380 (generate endpoint idempotency section) until platform confirms retry semantics for streaming vs non-streaming requests. preview implies server will transparently retry network errors. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4380
ci-bot: docs-preview: snapshot mismatch on /api-reference/generate (build 912) :warning:
oscar.platform: short answer: we DO NOT auto-retry streaming requests. non-streaming generate calls may be retried by the service only when an `idempotency_key` is provided and the error is transient (5xx or network timeout) within a 30s window. streaming requests are considered non-idempotent and are not retried server-side.
lucy.sdk: SDK note: client libs expose `idempotency_key` and a `retry_policy` object. current SDK defaults: no client-side automatic retries for streaming calls; non-streaming calls have a conservative retry (3 attempts) only if idempotency_key is set. we'll add explicit snippets.
harry.qe: confirmed in tests: if a streaming SSE connection fails mid-stream we emit an error and do NOT restart the stream. documented behaviour should recommend the client re-issue request with same idempotency_key only for non-streaming flows. also add a recommended pattern for resumable interactions (use short-turn tokens or chunked prompts).
nina.docs: perfect. i'll update PR copy: (1) remove the line implying transparent server retries for streaming, (2) add idempotency_key examples for non-streaming retryability, (3) add a clear sentence: "Streaming requests are not retried by the platform; clients must handle reconnection." assigning reviewers: @lucy.sdk @oscar.platform. holding merge until preview rebuild shows the new wording.
devops-bot: preview rebuild requested for PR 4380 (build 913). logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/913 :robot_face:
ci-bot: docs-preview: success (build 913) :tada:
lucy.sdk: LGTM, tiny nit on sample code.
oscar.platform: approved. merge when green.
nina.docs: merging after squash. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
